[i]5 days ago..

3 days after the formation of the expedition force for Ottominus, a light division of 5,300 footmen for the expedition travelled to where the city of Ottominus was once remembered to be. On arrival there, they were greeted by a city stuck in the past. People seemed to be wearing 80s or 90s apparel, most building designs did not change, and the city hall still stood tall in the main street. The people greeted the expedition force with confused faces and the city began to panic, fearing a takeover from a neighboring nation, the local military of the city began springing into action, an equal force of 6,000 men, army men and police with obsolete equipment began fortifying positions throughout and asked the expedition force, "What is your business?". In response, the leader of the force, sanguinian general, Armani Giorgo responded, "We are operating on behalf of the most Serene Republic of Sanguivallis and mean no harm." 
The local force in Ottominus took not to the kind reply and in turn, sprayed the expedition forces with tear gas and used non lethal weapons against them, pushing the expedition forces outside the city. The general, trying to avoid any means of violence, contacted reinforcements in Sanguivallis, and, with some skirmishes, in 2 weeks an additional force of 8,000 men strong merged with the 5,300 men strong, creating a force of 13,300 men strong. In the morning the next day on 6:00 AM, Sanguinian forces marched into the city. When spotted by patrolling police, the military immediately began mobilizing their forces, however they were immediately overwhelmed after general Giorgo told his men not to kill, but to injure enemy forces, and also directed bait forces into the main city while the bigger portion flanked into the western portion of the city and stormed city hall. The self proclaimed leader, was found hyperventilating in his office, and was held hostage by General Giorgo. General Giorgo forced the leader of the Ottominus city state to contact his general and tell him to stand down as he surrendered into General Giorgo's hands.

The overall operation was a success and only lasted 1 day and 6 hours, 90 men lost their lives while 800 were injured in the Ottominian side. 23 men lost their lives and 211 were injured in the Sanguinian side.[/i]
